title: Delivery Desk Terms for the Finished Commissioned Piece
content:
# Delivery Desk Terms for the Finished Commissioned Piece

The finished piece on a commission under Belrose Design Studio Custom Commissions is handed over on the programme's delivery method, and the programmes that deliver in person do so by appointment with the customer present. The piece is handed over only while the commission stands ready for delivery or already delivered, and never before the balance has reached zero. A finished piece left uncollected past the programme's holding period carries the programme's storage charge for each started month it stays in the studio. An appraisal is prepared with the finished piece under the programmes that include one, valued on the basis the programme names, and a laboratory certificate is obtained for the centre stone where the programme includes one. Delivery is taken by the customer, because receiving a piece made to their own specification is theirs alone to do. A storage charge on a finished piece left uncollected is booked to the commission as its own entry under the storage reason for each started month it stays, so the months can be counted from the entries themselves.

## The two conditions on handing over

| Condition | Basis | Met when |
|---|---|---|
| The stage | The commission record, correlated by its commission reference, read before the piece is handed over | The commission stands ready for delivery or already delivered |
| The balance | What the customer still owes on the commission | The balance has reached zero |

Neither condition is satisfied by an assurance: the piece is not handed over before the balance has reached zero, whatever is promised about payment to follow.

## Storage on an uncollected piece

A finished piece left uncollected past the programme's holding period in calendar days carries the programme's storage charge for each started month it stays in the studio, booked to the commission as its own entry under the storage reason for each such month.

*Hypothetical.* A piece finished under a programme whose holding period is 45 calendar days and whose storage charge is USD 35.00 a month, collected 80 calendar days after completion: 35 calendar days fall past the holding period, which is two started months, and two storage entries of USD 35.00 stand on the commission.

## What comes with the finished piece

An appraisal is prepared under the programmes that include one, valued on the basis that programme names; a laboratory certificate is obtained for the centre stone under the programmes that include one; and the piece is handed over on the programme's delivery method, in person and by appointment with the customer present under the programmes that deliver in person.
